subject: Model mix & pricing qualification follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T16:32:00-07:00
Subject: Model mix & pricing qualification follow-up

Thanks again for taking the call today, Alex — great discussion. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together an accurate cost estimate for BrightLayer.

Recap (what we heard)
- Target launch: pilot with 50k MAU (approx 6M messages/month) starting Q4.
- Expected model mix (ballpark from call): chat generation for UI and assistants, embeddings for semantic search, light reranking on top of search.
- Current procurement target: $/1M tokens target to hit your internal threshold (you mentioned looking for ~$350-450 per 1M tokens across the mix).
- Data/Security: BrightLayer needs SOC2 evidence and VPC/private deployment options (we noted Private as an option; we'll include notes).

Key ask to confirm (please reply with numbers):
1) Per-model monthly token split you expect (percent or absolute tokens). Example below — please confirm or correct:
   - Chat (completion + chat context): 70%
   - Embeddings (text->vector): 25%
   - Rerank (reranking calls): 5%
2) Monthly token volume (approx): are we aligned on ~1.5B tokens/month (this is ~6M messages * ~250 tokens avg)? If different, please send your expected volume buckets.
3) Budget range for pilot and ramp (monthly): what is the procurement ballpark you want us to target?

What we'll deliver after you confirm:
- A per-model unit economics sheet with options: Hosted API pricing, Dedicated reserved pool estimate, and Private (on-prem/VPC) ballpark.
- Target $/1M tokens modeling to hit your stated budget (we'll show sensitivity for avg tokens/message and batching gains).
- Attach a first-pass MIP (pricing worksheet) and an example SOW template for procurement.

Next steps:
- If the split/volume above looks right, reply and we'll send an initial estimate + calendar link for a 30-min walk-through.

Attachments: MIP-pricing-sheet.xlsx (first-pass worksheet)

Thanks — I can jump on a quick sync to walk through the numbers once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlayer.com
Date: 2027-06-14T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing qualification follow-up

Thanks Marissa — summary looks right. Quick confirmations and clarifications below: 

1) Model mix — confirmed approximate split:
   - Chat (UI assistants + conversational flows): 65-75% (use 70% as baseline)
   - Embeddings (semantic search & augmentation): 20-30% (use 25%)
   - Rerank (after retrieval): 3-6% (use 5%)

2) Volume — pilot: we expect ~6M messages/month; average tokens per message is tough to pin down but assume 200-300 tokens/message depending on chat depth. Using 250 tokens/message gives ~1.5B tokens/month (agrees with your calc).

3) Budget — procurement wants a target in the $300-450 per 1M tokens range for the pilot to consider moving to a reserved commitment. If you can show a Hosted vs Dedicated delta where Dedicated gets us below $350/1M tokens at our volumes, that will get faster traction.

4) Security — please include SOC2 + VPC on the estimate (we'll escalate if needed).

If you can get a first-pass estimate by EOD Tuesday that'd be ideal — procurement has an internal review on Wednesday. Happy to do a 30-min walkthrough Thursday morning PT.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of ML | BrightLayer
ax.rivera@brightlayer.com

Forwarding Alex's confirmation — procurement wants a target $300-450 / 1M tokens and will prioritize Dedicated if it gets under $350/1M at 1.5B tokens/month.

Dev — can you put together a pricing worksheet that shows:
- Per-model unit cost assumptions (chat vs embeddings vs rerank). Call out tokenization assumptions and avg tokens/message (show 200/250/300 sensitivity).
- Hosted API estimate (per-token rates we would quote).
- Dedicated reserved pool estimate (monthly commit and effective $/1M tokens at 1.5B tokens/month).
- Notes on quantization/quantized model variants we would recommend for embeddings vs chat to reduce cost.
- SOC2 & VPC add-on cost notes (high level).

Attach first draft pricing_model_mix_v1.xlsx to the reply — procurement wants a PDF they can annotate for internal review. Neha — please review for deal desk (pricing guardrails) and flag anything that needs approval.

Thanks — timeline: EOD Tuesday for first draft, 30-min sync Thursday AM PT to review with BrightLayer.

Marissa

Alex — thanks for the quick confirmation. Attached is an initial estimate (redwood-estimate-0615.pdf) that captures the baseline numbers and two pricing pathways (Hosted API vs Dedicated reserved). Highlights:
- Baseline model mix used: Chat 70% / Embeddings 25% / Rerank 5%
- Assumed avg tokens/message: 250 -> ~1.5B tokens/month
- Hosted estimate: ~ $480 / 1M tokens (baseline; shows batching and cache optimizations bring effective down to ~$400 at higher concurrency)
- Dedicated estimate (reserved): ~ $320 / 1M tokens at 1.5B tokens/month (includes reserved capacity discount assumptions)
- SOC2 + VPC add-on: one-time onboarding + monthly fee (noted in sheet).

Would you like us to convert the attached worksheet to a one-page procurement-ready PDF for your team? Also proposing a 30-min walkthrough Thursday 9:30 AM PT — works for us if it works for you.

Next steps:
- Alex to confirm 9:30 AM PT Thursday or propose another time.
- Dev to finalize the pricing_model_mix_v1.xlsx and we will share a procurement PDF copy for your team.

Thanks — talk soon.
